newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey seeks $2.6 billion from power distribution.
newsitem.headline: Turkey seeks $2.6 billion from power distribution.

text.p: Turkey is aiming to raise $2.625 billion from the leasing of power distribution networks for 30 years in 25 regions, an energy official said on Thursday.
Leading Turkish industrial groups such as Koc Holding and the Sabanci group are among 150 companies involved in the tender process beginning this week.
"The evaluation will last two months. After that we will make an announcement," said Mehmet Koyuncu, general director of energy affairs in Turkey, at a meeting to announce bidding details.
Companies are to give an offer price to buy electricity from the state-run electricity company TEAS over the 30 year period.
